name: Roquefort Blue Cheese (Penicillium Mold WARNING)
whyItWorks: Inoculated with active cultures of Penicillium roqueforti mold, creating dense veins of fungal mycelium. The high levels of free butyric acid, methyl ketones, and histamine produce burning sensations and inflammatory spasms along ulcerated mucosal tissue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: STRICTLY AVOID. Stick to mild, non-mold aged cheeses like Swiss or White Cheddar.
